exposure: MRI findings: focal outward contour bulge (B1)
MRI findings: breach (B2) in the placental-myometrial interface
MRI findings: T2 dark intra-placental bands (B3)
MRI findings: increased placental blood vessels (B4)
outcome: Type of abnormal placentation (placenta accreta, increta, percreta)
cohort: 110 pregnant women (aged 20-45 years) with obstetric MRIs for abnormal placentation during their third trimesters (24-30 weeks) were included.
finding: Specific combinations of MRI placental findings (bulge, breach, T2 dark intra-placental bands, and increased placental blood vessels) significantly helped predict the type of abnormal placentation.
cross-section timing: MRIs performed during the third trimester (24-30 weeks) between April 2014 and 2024.
